answer: In a sable-dark agent market where every new identity flares like a comet, superlinear registration bonds resist sybils: each identity tied to one proof-of-human root posts a bond scaling with the SQUARE of its siblings. One honest agent pays 1 unit; an attacker minting 1,000 fakes owes 1,000^2 = 1,000,000 units, not a linear 1,000. To break it he must forge 1,000 distinct human roots, each an expensive signal no cheap comet-swarm of clones can emit.
